# vendor/ten-levels

The files from [disler/ten-levels-of-jev](https://github.com/disler/ten-levels-of-jev) that jev-claude uses, copied unchanged from `apps/ten-levels/` at commit [`777adaf`](https://github.com/disler/ten-levels-of-jev/tree/777adaf47d37ae0553220d35b2f15b3a3a063305/apps/ten-levels) (2026-09-27). MIT licensed; see `LICENSE`.

Only the core client and levels 6–9 are here, plus what they import. To update, copy the same paths from a newer commit and change the commit above.
